_doc: Copy this file to labels.json and fill in real listings. zillowId must exist in your listings table; the script joins on listings.zillow_id and pulls photo_urls from that row. Each listing should have ground truth on as many fields as you can confidently judge from the photos. Leave a field out if you can't tell from the photos — the eval skips unlabeled fields. The judgmentCalls array is for the hard cases (renovation vs cosmetic, material confusion) — write what a human expert would say so we can score whether each model gets the nuance right.

listings.addressNote: Optional human reference like '123 Maple Ave, Austin' — not used by the script

judgmentCalls.description: Kitchen description says 'fully renovated' but cabinets are clearly original raised-panel oak with new hardware
judgmentCalls.expected: Should flag this as cosmetic-only update, not a real renovation

judgmentCalls.description: Photo 4 shows what looks like hardwood but the grain pattern repeats — it's high-quality LVP
judgmentCalls.expected: Should identify as vinyl/LVP, not hardwood

_validValues._doc: Reference for what to put in groundTruth fields. Models will use similar terminology.
